Message.Name: Aggregate Order Book Message
Message.Description: Sent whenever there is an order book change within the top fifteen price levels. The TimeOfEvent is the latest incoming event timestamp that resulted in any price level being updated or removed; for orders submitted during Pre-Open and reloaded GTC and GTD orders it reflects the uncrossing event time at market open.

Field.Name: TimeOfEvent
Field.Description: The time LMEselect updated the order book, triggering an Aggregate Order Book message.

Field.Name: NoEntries
Field.Description: Number of book entries within the message.

Field.Name: Entries
Field.Description: One entry per price level and side carried by this message.
